privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected annual energy for a 50 MW DC plant in Phoenix with these specs is approximately 106,080,846 kWh. Valid simulation results should fall within the range of 90,000,000 to 130,000,000 kWh. The key differentiator is that DC-coupling should show higher energy capture due to the recovery of clipped energy (DC-to-AC ratio of 1.25).
